email.mime.text import MIMEText\nfrom email.mime.multipart import MIMEMultipart\n\ndef notify_scc_finding(event, context):\n    """Triggered by Pub/Sub message from SCC continuous export."""\n\n    # Decode Pub/Sub message\n    pubsub_data = base64.b64decode(event[\'data\']).decode(\'utf-8\')\n    finding_data = json.loads(pubsub_data)\n\n    # Extract key fields\n    finding = state       = finding.get(\'state\', \'N/A\')\n    resource    = finding_data.get(\'resource\', {}).get(\'name\', \'N/A\')\n    event_time  = finding.get(\'eventTime\', \'N/A\')\n\n    # Build email body\n    subject = f"🚨 SCC Alert [{severity}]: {category}"\n    body = f"""\n    New SCC Finding Detected:\n    ─────────────────────────────\n    Category   : {category}\n    Severity   : {severity}\n    State      : {state}\n    Resource   : {resource}\n    Event Time : {event_time}\n    Finding ID : {name}\n    ─────────────────────────────\n    Review in SCC Console:\n    https://console.cloud.google.com/security/command-center/findings\n    """\n\n    # Send email (using SMTP or SendGrid — see below)\n    send_email(subject, body)\n\ndef send_email(subject, body):\n Click **Create Secret**\n\n### Via gcloud CLI:\n```bash\necho -n "SG.xxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxx.xxxxxxxx..." | \\\n  gcloud secrets create sendgrid-api-key \\\n    --data-file=- \\\n    --project=[PROJECT_ID]\n```\n\n---\n\n## ✅ Step 3 — Confirm Your Pub/Sub Topic & Subscription\n\n### 3a. Deploy Cloud Function\\&quot;, \\&quot;status\\&quot;: \\&quot;in_progress\\&quot;}, {\\&quot;id\\&quot;: \\&quot;5\\&quot;, \\&quot;content\\&quot;: \\&quot;Step 5 — Set IAM Permissions\\&quot;, \\&quot;status\\&quot;: \\&quot;pending\\&quot;}, {\\&quot;id\\&quot;: \\&quot;6\\&quot;, \\&quot;content\\&quot;: \\&quot;Step 6 — Test End-to-End\\&quot;, \\&quot;status\\&quot;: \\&quot;pending\\&quot;}], \\&quot;summary\\&quot;: {\\&quot;total\\&quot;: 6, \\&quot;pending\\&quot;: 2, \\&quot;in_progress\\&quot;: 1, \\&quot;completed\\&quot;: 3, \\&quot;cancelled\\&quot;: 0}}&quot;\n</details>\n## ✅ Step 4 — Create & Deploy the Cloud Function\n\n### 4a. Go to Cloud Functions\n1. **GCP Console → Cloud Functions → Create Function**\n\n### 4b. Configure Basics\n\n| Field | Value |\n|---|---|\n| **Environment** | 2nd gen *(recommended)* |\n| **Function name** | `scc-sendgrid-email-alert` |\n| **Region** | `us-central1` *(or your preferred region)* |\n| **Trigger type** | `Cloud Pub/Sub` |\n| **Pub/Sub topic** | *(select your snbx04 topic)* |\n\n### 4c. Configure Runtime & Security\n\n| Field | Value |\n|---|---|\n| **Runtime** | `Python 3.11` |\n| **Entry point** | `notify_scc_finding` |\n| **Service account** | *(create or use dedicated SA — see Step 5)* |\n\n### 4d. Add Secret Manager Reference\nUnder **Runtime → Security → References → Secret Manager secrets:**\n1. Click **Reference a secret**\n2. Select `sendgrid-api-key`\n3. **Exposed as:** Environment variable\n4. **Environment variable name:** `SENDGRID_API_KEY`\n5. **Version:** `latest`\n\n### 4e. Add Environment Variables\nUnder **Runtime → Environment variables → Add variable:**\n\n| Name | Value |\n|---|---|\n| `SENDER_EMAIL` | `alerts@yourdomain.gov` *(must be SendGrid verified sender)* |\n| `RECIPIENT_EMAIL` | `security-team@yourdomain.gov` |\n| `PROJECT_ID` | `your-gcp-project-id` |\n\n### 4f. Write the Function Code\nClick **Next → Inline Editor**, then set up these two files:\n\n#### 📄 `main.py`\n```python\nimport base64\nimport json\nimport os\nfrom google.cloud import secretmanager\nimport sendgrid\nfrom sendgrid.helpers.mail import Mail, Content\n\ndef notify_scc_finding(event, context):\n    """\n    Cloud Function triggered by Pub/Sub from SCC Continuous Export.\n    Parses the finding and sends an alert email via SendGrid.\n    """\n    try:\n        # ── 1. Decode Pub/Sub message ──────────────────────────────\n        pubsub_message = base64.b64decode(event[\'data\']).decode(\'utf-8\')\n        finding_data   = json.loads(pubsub_message)\n\n        # ── 2. Extract finding fields ──────────────────────────────\n        finding    = finding_data.get(\'finding\', {})\n        category   = finding.get(\'category\', \'N/A\')\n        severity   = finding.get(\'severity\', \'N/A\')\n        state      = finding.get(\'state\', \'N/A\')\n        event_time = finding.get(\'eventTime\', \'N/A\')\n        finding_id = finding.get(\'name\', \'N/A\')\n        resource   = finding_data.get(\'resource\', {}).get(\'displayName\', \'N/A\')\n        project    = finding_data.get(\'resource\', {}).get(\'projectDisplayName\', \'N/A\')\n\n        # ── 3. Build email content ─────────────────────────────────\n        subject = f"🚨 SCC [{severity}] Finding: {category}"\n\n        html_body = f"""\n        <html><body>\n        <h2 style="color:{\'red\' if severity==\'CRITICAL\' else \'orange\'}">\n            🚨 SCC Security Finding Detected\n        </h2>\n        <table border="1" cellpadding="8" cellspacing="0">\n            <tr><td><b>Category</b></td><td>{category}</td></tr>\n            <tr><td><b>Severity</b></td><td>{severity}</td></tr>\n            <tr><td><b>State</b></td><td>{state}</td></tr>\n            <tr><td><b>Resource</b></td><td>{resource}</td></tr>\n            <tr><td><b>Project</b></td><td>{project}</td></tr>\n            <tr><td><b>Event Time</b></td><td>{event_time}</td></tr>\n            <tr><td><b>Finding ID</b></td><td>{finding_id}</td></tr>\n        </table>\n        <br>\n        <a href="https://console.cloud.google.com/security/command-center/findings">\n            🔗 View in SCC Console\n        </a>\n        </body></html>\n        """\n\n        # ── 4. Send email via SendGrid ─────────────────────────────\n        api_key   = os.environ[\'SENDGRID_API_KEY\']\n        sender    = os.environ[\'SENDER_EMAIL\']\n        recipient = os.environ[\'RECIPIENT_EMAIL\']\n\n        sg      = sendgrid.SendGridAPIClient(api_key=api_key)\n        message = Mail(\n            from_email    = sender,\n            to_emails     = recipient,\n            subject       = subject,\n            html_content  = Content("text/html", html_body)\n        )\n\n        response = sg.send(message)\n        print(f"✅ Email sent | Status: {response.status_code} | Finding: {category} [{severity}]")\n\n    except Exception as e:\n        print(f"❌ Error processing SCC finding: {str(e)}")\n        raise\n```\n\n#### 📄 `requirements.txt`\n```\nsendgrid==6.11.0\ngoogle-cloud-secret-manager==2.20.0\n```\n\n### 4g. Deploy\n1. Click **Deploy**\n2. Step 4 — Create & Deploy the Cloud Function\n\n### 4a. Go to Cloud Functions\n1. **GCP Console → Cloud Functions → Create Function**\n\n### 4b. Configure Basics\n\n| Field | Value |\n|---|---|\n| **Environment** | 2nd gen *(recommended)* |\n| **Function name** | `scc-sendgrid-email-alert` |\n| **Region** | `us-central1` *(or your preferred region)* |\n| **Trigger type** | `Cloud Pub/Sub` |\n| **Pub/Sub topic** | *(select your snbx04 topic)* |\n\n### 4c. Configure Runtime & Security\n\n| Field | Value |\n|---|---|\n| **Runtime** | `Python 3.11` |\n| **Entry point** | `notify_scc_finding` |\n| **Service account** | *(create or use dedicated SA — see Step 5)* |\n\n### 4d. Add Secret Manager Reference\nUnder **Runtime → Security → References → Secret Manager secrets:**\n1. Click **Reference a secret**\n2. Select `sendgrid-api-key`\n3. **Exposed as:** Environment variable\n4. **Environment variable name:** `SENDGRID_API_KEY`\n5. **Version:** `latest`\n\n### 4e. Add Environment Variables\nUnder **Runtime → Environment variables → Add variable:**\n\n| Name | Value |\n|---|---|\n| `SENDER_EMAIL` | `alerts@yourdomain.gov` *(must be SendGrid verified sender)* |\n| `RECIPIENT_EMAIL` | `security-team@yourdomain.gov` |\n| `PROJECT_ID` | `your-gcp-project-id` |\n\n### 4f. Write the Function Code\nClick **Next → Inline Editor**, then set up these two files:\n\n#### 📄 `main.py`\n```python\nimport base64\nimport json\nimport os\nfrom google.cloud import secretmanager\nimport sendgrid\nfrom sendgrid.helpers.mail import Mail, Content\n\ndef notify_scc_finding(event, context):\n    """\n    Cloud Function triggered by Pub/Sub from SCC Continuous Export.\n    Parses the finding and sends an alert email via SendGrid.\n    """\n    try:\n        # ── 1. Decode Pub/Sub message ──────────────────────────────\n        pubsub_message = base64.b64decode(event[\'data\']).decode(\'utf-8\')\n        finding_data   = json.loads(pubsub_message)\n\n        # ── 2. Extract finding fields ──────────────────────────────\n        finding    = finding_data.get(\'finding\', {})\n        category   = finding.get(\'category\', \'N/A\')\n        severity   = finding.get(\'severity\', \'N/A\')\n        state      = finding.get(\'state\', \'N/A\')\n        event_time = finding.get(\'eventTime\', \'N/A\')\n        finding_id = finding.get(\'name\', \'N/A\')\n        resource   = finding_data.get(\'resource\', {}).get(\'displayName\', \'N/A\')\n        project    = finding_data.get(\'resource\', {}).get(\'projectDisplayName\', \'N/A\')\n\n        # ── 3. Build email content ─────────────────────────────────\n        subject = f"🚨 SCC [{severity}] Finding: {category}"\n\n        html_body = f"""\n        <html><body>\n        <h2 style="color:{\'red\' if severity==\'CRITICAL\' else \'orange\'}">\n            🚨 SCC Security Finding Detected\n        </h2>\n        <table border="1" cellpadding="8" cellspacing="0">\n            <tr><td><b>Category</b></td><td>{category}</td></tr>\n            <tr><td><b>Severity</b></td><td>{severity}</td></tr>\n            <tr><td><b>State</b></td><td>{state}</td></tr>\n            <tr><td><b>Resource</b></td><td>{resource}</td></tr>\n            <tr><td><b>Project</b></td><td>{project}</td></tr>\n            <tr><td><b>Event Time</b></td><td>{event_time}</td></tr>\n            <tr><td><b>Finding ID</b></td><td>{finding_id}</td></tr>\n        </table>\n        <br>\n        <a href="https://console.cloud.google.com/security/command-center/findings">\n            🔗 View in SCC Console\n        </a>\n        </body></html>\n        """\n\n        # ── 4. Send email via SendGrid ─────────────────────────────\n        api_key   = os.environ[\'SENDGRID_API_KEY\']\n        sender    = os.environ[\'SENDER_EMAIL\']\n        recipient = os.environ[\'RECIPIENT_EMAIL\']\n\n        sg      = sendgrid.SendGridAPIClient(api_key=api_key)\n        message = Mail(\n            from_email    = sender,\n            to_emails     = recipient,\n            subject       = subject,\n            html_content  = Content("text/html", html_body)\n        )\n\n        response = sg.send(message)\n        print(f"✅ Email sent | Status: {response.status_code} | Finding: {category} [{severity}]")\n\n    except Exception as e:\n        print(f"❌ Error processing SCC finding: {str(e)}")\n        raise\n```\n\n#### 📄 `requirements.txt`\n```\nsendgrid==6.11.0\ngoogle-cloud-secret-manager==2.20.0\n```\n\n### 4g. Deploy\n1. Click **Deploy**\n2. Wait ~2–3 minutes for deployment ⏳\n3. ✅ Status shows green checkmark when ready\n\n---'}]}, {'type': 'function_call', 'id': 'toolu_vrtx_012F1dCEWWQwnfsGBrqXwt9g', 'call_id': Deploy Cloud Function\\&quot;, \\&quot;status\\&quot;: \\&quot;in_progress\\&quot;}, {\\&quot;id\\&quot;: \\&quot;5\\&quot;, \\&quot;content\\&quot;: \\&quot;Step 5 — Set IAM Permissions\\&quot;, \\&quot;status\\&quot;: \\&quot;pending\\&quot;}, {\\&quot;id\\&quot;: \\&quot;6\\&quot;, \\&quot;content\\&quot;: \\&quot;Step 6 — Test End-to-End\\&quot;, \\&quot;status\\&quot;: \\&quot;pending\\&quot;}], \\&quot;summary\\&quot;: {\\&quot;total\\&quot;: 6, \\&quot;pending\\&quot;: 2, \\&quot;in_progress\\&quot;: 1, \\&quot;completed\\&quot;: 3, \\&quot;cancelled\\&quot;: 0}}&quot;\n</details>\n## ✅ Step 4 — Create & Deploy the Cloud Function\n\n### 4a. Go to Cloud Functions\n1. **GCP Console → Cloud Functions → Create Function**\n\n### 4b. Configure Basics\n\n| Field | Value |\n|---|---|\n| **Environment** | 2nd gen *(recommended)* |\n| **Function name** | `scc-sendgrid-email-alert` |\n| **Region** | `us-central1` *(or your preferred region)* |\n| **Trigger type** | `Cloud Pub/Sub` |\n| **Pub/Sub topic** | *(select your snbx04 topic)* |\n\n### 4c. Configure Runtime & Security\n\n| Field | Value |\n|---|---|\n| **Runtime** | `Python 3.11` |\n| **Entry point** | `notify_scc_finding` |\n| **Service account** | *(create or use dedicated SA — see Step 5)* |\n\n### 4d. Add Secret Manager Reference\nUnder **Runtime → Security → References → Secret Manager secrets:**\n1. Click **Reference a secret**\n2. Select `sendgrid-api-key`\n3. **Exposed as:** Environment variable\n4. **Environment variable name:** `SENDGRID_API_KEY`\n5. **Version:** `latest`\n\n### 4e. Add Environment Variables\nUnder **Runtime → Environment variables → Add variable:**\n\n| Name | Value |\n|---|---|\n| `SENDER_EMAIL` | `alerts@yourdomain.gov` *(must be SendGrid verified sender)* |\n| `RECIPIENT_EMAIL` | `security-team@yourdomain.gov` |\n| `PROJECT_ID` | `your-gcp-project-id` |\n\n### 4f. Write the Function Code\nClick **Next → Inline Editor**, then set up these two files:\n\n#### 📄 `main.py`\n```python\nimport base64\nimport json\nimport os\nfrom google.cloud import secretmanager\nimport sendgrid\nfrom sendgrid.helpers.mail import Mail, Content\n\ndef notify_scc_finding(event, context):\n    """\n    Cloud Function triggered by Pub/Sub from SCC Continuous Export.\n    Parses the finding and sends an alert email via SendGrid.\n    """\n    try:\n        # ── 1. Decode Pub/Sub message ──────────────────────────────\n        pubsub_message = base64.b64decode(event[\'data\']).decode(\'utf-8\')\n        finding_data   = json.loads(pubsub_message)\n\n        # ── 2. Extract finding fields ──────────────────────────────\n        finding    = finding_data.get(\'finding\', {})\n        category   = finding.get(\'category\', \'N/A\')\n        severity   = finding.get(\'severity\', \'N/A\')\n        state      = finding.get(\'state\', \'N/A\')\n        event_time = finding.get(\'eventTime\', \'N/A\')\n        finding_id = finding.get(\'name\', \'N/A\')\n        resource   = finding_data.get(\'resource\', {}).get(\'displayName\', \'N/A\')\n        project    = finding_data.get(\'resource\', {}).get(\'projectDisplayName\', \'N/A\')\n\n        # ── 3. Build email content ─────────────────────────────────\n        subject = f"🚨 SCC [{severity}] Finding: {category}"\n\n        html_body = f"""\n        <html><body>\n        <h2 style="color:{\'red\' if severity==\'CRITICAL\' else \'orange\'}">\n            🚨 SCC Security Finding Detected\n        </h2>\n        <table border="1" cellpadding="8" cellspacing="0">\n            <tr><td><b>Category</b></td><td>{category}</td></tr>\n            <tr><td><b>Severity</b></td><td>{severity}</td></tr>\n            <tr><td><b>State</b></td><td>{state}</td></tr>\n            <tr><td><b>Resource</b></td><td>{resource}</td></tr>\n            <tr><td><b>Project</b></td><td>{project}</td></tr>\n            <tr><td><b>Event Time</b></td><td>{event_time}</td></tr>\n            <tr><td><b>Finding ID</b></td><td>{finding_id}</td></tr>\n        </table>\n        <br>\n        <a href="https://console.cloud.google.com/security/command-center/findings">\n            🔗 View in SCC Console\n        </a>\n        </body></html>\n        """\n\n        # ── 4. Send email via SendGrid ─────────────────────────────\n        api_key   = os.environ[\'SENDGRID_API_KEY\']\n        sender    = os.environ[\'SENDER_EMAIL\']\n        recipient = os.environ[\'RECIPIENT_EMAIL\']\n\n        sg      = sendgrid.SendGridAPIClient(api_key=api_key)\n        message = Mail(\n            from_email    = sender,\n            to_emails     = recipient,\n            subject       = subject,\n            html_content  = Content("text/html", html_body)\n        )\n\n        response = sg.send(message)\n        print(f"✅ Email sent | Status: {response.status_code} | Finding: {category} [{severity}]")\n\n    except Exception as e:\n        print(f"❌ Error processing SCC finding: {str(e)}")\n        raise\n```\n\n#### 📄 `requirements.txt`\n```\nsendgrid==6.11.0\ngoogle-cloud-secret-manager==2.20.0\n```\n\n### 4g. Deploy\n1. Click **Deploy**\n2. Wait ~2–3 minutes for deployment ⏳\n3. ✅ Status shows green checkmark when ready\n\n---\n<details type="tool_calls" done="true" id="toolu_vrtx_012F1dCEWWQwnfsGBrqXwt9g" name="update_task" arguments="&quot;{\\&quot;id\\&quot;: \\&quot;4\\&quot;, \\&quot;status\\&quot;: \\&quot;completed\\&quot;}&quot;" files="" embeds="&quot;&quot;">\n<summary>Tool Executed</summary>\n&quot;{\\&quot;tasks\\&quot;: [{\\&quot;id\\&quot;: \\&quot;1\\&quot;, \\&quot;content\\&quot;: \\&quot;Step 1 — Create a SendGrid Account &amp; You can create an alerting policy that sends email directly — **no Cloud Functions, no SendGrid needed.**\n\n### Steps:\n1. **GCP Console → Monitoring → Alerting → Create Policy**\n2. **Add Condition:**\n   - Condition type: `Log-based alert`\n   - Under **Log-based metric**, create a metric filtering SCC findings:\n     ```\n     resource.type="organization"\n     protoPayload.serviceName="securitycenter.googleapis.com"\n     severity=("CRITICAL" OR "HIGH")\n     ```\n3. **Add Notification Channel:**\n   - Click **Manage Notification Channels**\n   - Add **Email** → enter recipient address\n   - ✅ No third-party service needed!\n4. **Set alert frequency** → e.g., `Daily` or `Per occurrence`\n\n### 💰 Cost:\n| Component | Cost |\n|---|---|\n| Cloud Monitoring Alerting | **Free** (up to 5 alerting policies) |\n| Email Notification Channel | **Free** |\n| Log-based Metrics | **Free** for first 50 GiB/month |\n\n---\n\n## ✅ Option 2: Pub/Sub → Cloud Run Jobs *(Lower cost than Cloud Functions)*\n> ☁️ **Cloud Run is significantly cheaper than Cloud Functions for infrequent triggers**\n\n### How it works:\n- Cloud Run only charges for **actual compute time used**\n- Free tier: **180,000 vCPU-seconds/month + 360,000 GB-seconds/month**\n- A Pub/Sub-triggered Cloud Run Job sending an email takes ~1–2 seconds per execution\n\n### Key Difference vs Cloud Functions:\n| | Cloud Functions | Cloud Run Jobs |\n|---|---|---|\n| **Free tier** | 2M invocations/month | 180K vCPU-sec/month |\n| **Cold start cost** | Higher | Lower |\n| **Best for** | Frequent triggers | Infrequent/batch |\n\n### For email sending — use **Gmail SMTP** (free) instead of SendGrid:\n```python\nimport smtplib, os\nfrom email.mime.text import MIMEText\n\ndef send_via_gmail(subject, body):\n    msg = MIMEText(body, \'html\')\n    msg[\'Subject\'] = subject\n    msg[\'From\']    = os.environ[\'GMAIL_USER\']\n    msg[\'To\']      = os.environ[\'RECIPIENT_EMAIL\']\n\n    with smtplib.SMTP_SSL(\'smtp.gmail.com\', 465) as smtp:\n        smtp.login(os.environ[\'GMAIL_USER\'], os.environ[\'GMAIL_APP_PASSWORD\'])\n        smtp.send_message(msg)\n```\n> 💡 Use a **Google Workspace service account** or Gmail App Password — both free.\n\n---\n\n## ✅ Option 3: Pub/Sub → Log Router → Cloud Logging → Email via Log Alerts *(Free)*\n> 📋 **Fully native, zero extra cost**\n\n### How it works:\n```\nSCC Findings\n     ↓\nLog Router (Sink) → Cloud Logging\n     ↓\nLog-based Alert → Email Notification Channel\n```\n\n### bucket`\n\n2. **GCP Console → Logging → Log-based Metrics → Create Metric**\n   - Filter for HIGH/CRITICAL SCC findings\n\n3. **GCP Console → Monitoring → Alerting → Create Policy**\n   - Based on the log-based metric\n   - Notification: **Email channel** (free)\n\n### 💰 Cost: **$0** within free tier limits\n\n---\n\n## ✅ Option 4: Pub/Sub → Eventarc → Gmail via Google Workspace APIs *(Low CRITICAL SCC finding appears in logs — which Cloud Monitoring then uses to trigger an alert.\n\n### 2a. Navigate to Log-Based Metrics\n1. **GCP Console → Logging → Log-based Metrics**\n2. Click **➕ Create Metric**\n\n### 2b. Configure the Metric\n\n| Field | Value |\n|---|---|\n| **Metric type** | `Counter` |\n| **Name** | `scc-high-critical-findings` |\n| **Description** | `Counts new HIGH and CRITICAL SCC findings` |\n| **Units** | `1` |\n\n### 2c. Build the Log Filter\n\nIn the **Filter** box, paste this filter to match your `snbx04-high-critical-dc` continuous export scope:\n\n```\nresource.type="organization"\nlogName="organizations/[ORG_ID]/logs/cloudaudit.googleapis.com%2Factivity"\nprotoPayload.methodName="google.cloud.securitycenter.v1.SecurityCenter.CreateFinding"\nprotoPayload.request.finding.severity=("CRITICAL" OR "HIGH")\nprotoPayload.request.finding.state="ACTIVE"\n```\n\n> 💡 **Alternative filter** — if your SCC findings flow through a specific project log:\n> ```\n> resource.type="audited_resource"\n> protoPayload.serviceName="securitycenter.googleapis.com"\n> severity=("CRITICAL" OR "ERROR")\n> ```\n\n### 2d. Add Labels *(Optional but recommended)*\nClick **Add Label** to extract useful fields from the log for email context:\n\n| Label Name | Field Name | Type |\n|---|---|---|\n| `severity` | `protoPayload.request.finding.severity` | String |\n| `category` | `protoPayload.request.finding.category` | String |\n| `resource_name` | `protoPayload.resourceName` | String |\n\n### 2e. Save\n- Click **Create Metric** ✅\n- The metric will appear under **Log-based Metrics → User-defined Metrics**\n\n> ⚠️ **Note:** The metric only starts counting **after** it\'s created — it won\'t backfill historical findings.\n<details type="tool_calls" done="true" id="toolu_vrtx_01RSYerYmWVH9w1kutZxNDHw" name="update_task" arguments="&quot;{\\&quot;id\\&quot;: \\&quot;2\\&quot;, \\&quot;status\\&quot;: \\&quot;completed\\&quot;}&quot;" files="" embeds="&quot;&quot;">\n<summary>Tool Executed</summary>\n&quot;{\\&quot;tasks\\&quot;: [{\\&quot;id\\&quot;: \\&quot;1\\&quot;, \\&quot;content\\&quot;: \\&quot;Step 1 — Enable Required APIs\\&quot;, \\&quot;status\\&quot;: \\&quot;completed\\&quot;}, {\\&quot;id\\&quot;: \\&quot;2\\&quot;, \\&quot;content\\&quot;: \\&quot;Step 2 — Create a Log-Based Metric for SCC Findings\\&quot;, \\&quot;status\\&quot;: \\&quot;completed\\&quot;}, {\\&quot;id\\&quot;: \\&quot;3\\&quot;, \\&quot;content\\&quot;: \\&quot;Step 3 — Set Up Email Notification Channel\\&quot;, \\&quot;status\\&quot;: \\&quot;pending\\&quot;}, {\\&quot;id\\&quot;: \\&quot;4\\&quot;, \\&quot;content\\&quot;: \\&quot;Step 4 — Create the Alerting Policy\\&quot;, \\&quot;status\\&quot;: \\&quot;pending\\&quot;}, {\\&quot;id\\&quot;: \\&quot;5\\&quot;, \\&quot;content\\&quot;: \\&quot;Step 5 — Verify &amp; Navigate to Notification Channels\n1. **GCP Console → Monitoring → Alerting**\n2. Click **Edit Notification Channels** (top right)\n   - OR go to: **Monitoring → Alerting → Notification Channels**\n\n### 3b. Add Email Channel\n1. Scroll to **Email** section → Click **➕ Add New**\n2. Fill in:\n\n| Field | Value |\n|---|---|\n| **Email Address** | `security-team@yourdomain.gov` |\n| **Display Name** | `SCC Security Alerts Team` |\n\n3. Click **Save** ✅\n\n### 3c. Add Multiple Recipients *(Optional)*\n> Cloud Monitoring supports **one email per channel**, but you can add multiple channels and assign them all to one alerting policy.\n\nRepeat Step 3b for each recipient:\n- `manager@yourdomain.gov` → Display Name: `Security Manager`\n- `soc-team@yourdomain.gov` → Display Name: `SOC Team`\n\n> 💡 **Tip:** Use a **Google Group / distribution list email** (e.g., `scc-alerts-group@yourdomain.gov`) as a single channel to notify many recipients at once — no need to add individual channels!\n\n### 3d. Verify the Channel\n- Google sends a **verification email** to the address\n- Click the verification link in that email to activate the channel ✅\n<details type="tool_calls" done="true" id="toolu_vrtx_01EcxPdHS771cWykQgjE7C6t" name="update_task" arguments="&quot;{\\&quot;id\\&quot;: \\&quot;3\\&quot;, \\&quot;status\\&quot;: \\&quot;completed\\&quot;}&quot;" files="" embeds="&quot;&quot;">\n<summary>Tool Executed</summary>\n&quot;{\\&quot;tasks\\&quot;: [{\\&quot;id\\&quot;: \\&quot;1\\&quot;, \\&quot;content\\&quot;: \\&quot;Step 1 — Enable Required APIs\\&quot;, \\&quot;status\\&quot;: \\&quot;completed\\&quot;}, {\\&quot;id\\&quot;: \\&quot;2\\&quot;, \\&quot;content\\&quot;: \\&quot;Step 2 — Create a Log-Based Metric for SCC Findings\\&quot;, \\&quot;status\\&quot;: \\&quot;completed\\&quot;}, {\\&quot;id\\&quot;: \\&quot;3\\&quot;, \\&quot;content\\&quot;: \\&quot;Step 3 — Set Up Email Notification Channel\\&quot;, \\&quot;status\\&quot;: \\&quot;completed\\&quot;}, {\\&quot;id\\&quot;: \\&quot;4\\&quot;, \\&quot;content\\&quot;: \\&quot;Step 4 — Create the Alerting Policy\\&quot;, \\&quot;status\\&quot;: \\&quot;pending\\&quot;}, {\\&quot;id\\&quot;: \\&quot;5\\&quot;, \\&quot;content\\&quot;: \\&quot;Step 5 — Verify &amp; Test the Alert\\&quot;, \\&quot;status\\&quot;: \\&quot;pending\\&quot;}, {\\&quot;id\\&quot;: \\&quot;6\\&quot;, \\&quot;content\\&quot;: \\&quot;Step 6 — Optional Tuning &amp; Best Practices\\&quot;, \\&quot;status\\&quot;: \\&quot;pending\\&quot;}], \\&quot;summary\\&quot;: {\\&quot;total\\&quot;: 6, \\&quot;pending\\&quot;: 2, \\&quot;in_progress\\&quot;: 1, \\&quot;completed\\&quot;: 3, \\&quot;cancelled\\&quot;: 0}}&quot;\n</details>\n---\n\n## 🔧 Step 4 — Create the Alerting Policy\n\n> This is the core step that **ties the log-based metric to the email notification.**\n\n### 4a. Navigate to Alerting\n1. **GCP Console → Monitoring → Alerting**\n2. Click **➕ Create Policy**\n\n---\n\n### 4b. Add a Condition (What triggers the alert)\n\n1. Click **➕ Add Condition**\n2. Select **"Metric threshold"**\n3. In the metric picker:\n   - Click **Select a metric**\n   - Under **Resource type**, select: `Global`\n   - Under **Metric**, search for: `scc-high-critical-findings`\n   - Select: `logging/user/scc-high-critical-findings`\n4. Configure the condition:\n\n| Field | Value |\n|---|---|\n| **Condition type** | `Threshold` |\n| **Alert trigger** | `Any time series violates` |\n| **Threshold position** | `Above threshold` |\n| **Threshold value** | `0` *(alert on ANY new finding)* |\n| **For** (duration) | `0 minutes` *(trigger immediately)* |\n\n5. Click **Next** ✅\n\n---\n\n### 4c. Configure Notifications (Who gets alerted)\n\n1. Under **Notification Channels**, click **Manage Notification Channels**\n2. Select the email channel(s) you created in Step 3:\n   - ✅ `SCC Security Alerts Team`\n   - ✅ *(any additional channels)*\n3. Click **OK**\n\n---\n\n### 4d. Configure Alert Details (Alert content)\n\n| Field | Value |\n|---|---|\n| **Alert policy name** | `SCC High-Critical Findings Alert` |\n| **Severity** | `Critical` |\n| **Documentation** | *(paste below)* |\n\nIn the **Documentation** field, add this custom message that will appear in every alert email:\n\n```\n🚨 New HIGH or CRITICAL SCC Finding Detected\n\nThis alert was triggered by the continuous export:\nsnbx04-high-critical-dc\n\nSeverity Filter : HIGH, CRITICAL\nState           : ACTIVE\n\n🔗 Review findings in SCC Console:\nhttps://console.cloud.google.com/security/command-center/findings\n\n📋 Filter to apply in SCC:\nseverity="HIGH" OR severity="CRITICAL"\nstate="ACTIVE"\n\nPlease review and remediate within your SLA window.\n```\n\n---\n\n### 4e. Set Notification Timing *(Daily Digest Option)*\n\n> By default, alerts fire on **every new finding**. To get a **daily digest** instead:\n\n1. Under **Notifications**, expand **Notification rate limit**\n2. Set: **"Notify at most every"** → `1 day`\n   - This batches alerts and sends **at most one email per day** ✅\n   - Ideal for avoiding alert fatigue from many findings\n\n---\n\n### 4f. Save the Policy\n1. Review all settings\n2. Click **Create Policy** ✅\n\nYour alerting policy is now **active and monitoring** for new HIGH/CRITICAL SCC findings!\n<details type="tool_calls" done="true" id="toolu_vrtx_018AkLt7Ya5rTQ5Nt9vFfJKA" name="update_task" arguments="&quot;{\\&quot;id\\&quot;: \\&quot;4\\&quot;, \\&quot;status\\&quot;: \\&quot;completed\\&quot;}&quot;" files="" embeds="&quot;&quot;">\n<summary>Tool Executed</summary>\n&quot;{\\&quot;tasks\\&quot;: [{\\&quot;id\\&quot;: \\&quot;1\\&quot;, \\&quot;content\\&quot;: \\&quot;Step 1 — Enable Required APIs\\&quot;, \\&quot;status\\&quot;: \\&quot;completed\\&quot;}, {\\&quot;id\\&quot;: \\&quot;2\\&quot;, \\&quot;content\\&quot;: \\&quot;Step 2 — Create a Log-Based Metric for SCC Findings\\&quot;, \\&quot;status\\&quot;: \\&quot;completed\\&quot;}, {\\&quot;id\\&quot;: \\&quot;3\\&quot;, \\&quot;content\\&quot;: \\&quot;Step 3 — Set Up Email Notification Channel\\&quot;, \\&quot;status\\&quot;: \\&quot;completed\\&quot;}, {\\&quot;id\\&quot;: \\&quot;4\\&quot;, \\&quot;content\\&quot;: \\&quot;Step 4 — Create the Alerting Policy\\&quot;, \\&quot;status\\&quot;: \\&quot;completed\\&quot;}, {\\&quot;id\\&quot;: \\&quot;5\\&quot;, \\&quot;content\\&quot;: \\&quot;Step 5 — Verify &amp; Confirm the Alerting Policy is Active\n1. **GCP Console → Monitoring → Alerting → Policies**\n2. Find `SCC High-Critical Findings Alert`\n3. Status should show: 🟢 **No incidents** (healthy/active)\n\n### 5b. Test by Writing a Test Log Entry\nUse **Log Explorer** to simulate a matching log entry:\n\n```bash\ngcloud logging write scc-test-log \\\n  \'{\n    "message": "Test SCC HIGH finding",\n    "severity": "CRITICAL",\n    "protoPayload": {\n      "serviceName": "securitycenter.googleapis.com",\n      "methodName": "google.cloud.securitycenter.v1.SecurityCenter.CreateFinding",\n      "request": {\n        "finding": {\n          "category": "OPEN_FIREWALL",\n          "severity": "CRITICAL",\n          "state": "ACTIVE"\n        }\n      }\n    }\n  }\' \\\n  --severity=CRITICAL \\\n  --project=[PROJECT_ID]\n```\n\n### 5c. Verify Alert Triggered\n1. **Monitoring → Alerting** → check for a new **Incident** entry\n2. Check your **email inbox** for the alert notification\n3. Check **SendGrid Activity** — *(N/A for this option — email is sent directly by Google)*\n\n### 5d. Check Log-Based Metric is Counting\n1. **Logging → Log-based Metrics → `scc-high-critical-findings`**\n2. Click the metric → **View in Metrics Explorer**\n3. Confirm the counter is incrementing ✅\n<details type="tool_calls" done="true" id="toolu_vrtx_01Hx8t9oso6GZuZDq4Qc2mVv" name="update_task" arguments="&quot;{\\&quot;id\\&quot;: \\&quot;5\\&quot;, \\&quot;status\\&quot;: \\&quot;completed\\&quot;}&quot;" files="" embeds="&quot;&quot;">\n<summary>Tool Executed</summary>\n&quot;{\\&quot;tasks\\&quot;: [{\\&quot;id\\&quot;: \\&quot;1\\&quot;, \\&quot;content\\&quot;: \\&quot;Step 1 — Enable Required APIs\\&quot;, \\&quot;status\\&quot;: \\&quot;completed\\&quot;}, {\\&quot;id\\&quot;: \\&quot;2\\&quot;, \\&quot;content\\&quot;: \\&quot;Step 2 — Create a Log-Based Metric for SCC Findings\\&quot;, \\&quot;status\\&quot;: \\&quot;completed\\&quot;}, {\\&quot;id\\&quot;: \\&quot;3\\&quot;, \\&quot;content\\&quot;: \\&quot;Step 3 — Set Up Email Notification Channel\\&quot;, \\&quot;status\\&quot;: \\&quot;completed\\&quot;}, {\\&quot;id\\&quot;: \\&quot;4\\&quot;, \\&quot;content\\&quot;: \\&quot;Step 4 — Create the Alerting Policy\\&quot;, \\&quot;status\\&quot;: \\&quot;completed\\&quot;}, {\\&quot;id\\&quot;: \\&quot;5\\&quot;, \\&quot;content\\&quot;: \\&quot;Step 5 — Verify &amp; Reduce Alert Fatigue — Notification Rate Limiting\n\n| Goal | Setting |\n|---|---|\n| Alert on every finding | Rate limit: `5 minutes` |\n| Daily digest summary | Rate limit: `1 day` |\n| Weekly summary | Rate limit: `1 week` |\n\nSet under: **Alerting Policy → Edit → Notifications → Notify at most every**\n\n---\n\n### 6b. Align Log Filter with Your SCC Continuous Export Filter\n\nSince your export `snbx04-high-critical-dc` already has a **specific filter**, mirror it exactly in your log-based metric filter. Common SCC filter fields:\n\n```\n# Match specific project (snbx04)\nprotoPayload.request.finding.resourceName=~"projects/snbx04"\n\n# Match severity\nprotoPayload.request.finding.severity=("CRITICAL" OR "HIGH")\n\n# Match only active findings (not resolved)\nprotoPayload.request.finding.state="ACTIVE"\n\n# Exclude specific categories if needed\nprotoPayload.request.finding.category!="MEDIUM_RISK_ONE"\n```\n\n---\n\n### 6c. Incident Auto-Close Setting\n\nUnder **Alerting Policy → Edit → Condition**:\n\n| Field | Recommended Value |\n|---|---|\n| **Incident auto-close duration** | `7 days` *(findings stay open until reviewed)* |\n\n---\n\n### 6d. Troubleshooting Quick Reference\n\n| Issue | Fix |\n|---|---|\n| No email received | Verify notification channel email ✅ |\n| Metric not counting | Check log filter matches actual SCC log entries |\n| Alert not firing | Confirm threshold is `> 0`, duration is `0 min` |\n| Too many emails | Increase notification rate limit to `1 day` |\n| Logs not appearing | Confirm SCC → Cloud Logging integration is enabled |\n\n---\n<details type="tool_calls" done="true" id="toolu_vrtx_01WzFotuT4riJsBUzCc6UdrP" name="update_task" arguments="&quot;{\\&quot;id\\&quot;: \\&quot;6\\&quot;, \\&quot;status\\&quot;: 'content': [{'type': 'output_text', 'text': '---\n\n## 🔧 Step 2 — Create a Log-Based Metric for SCC Findings\n\n> This creates a **counter metric** that increments every time a new HIGH or CRITICAL SCC finding appears in logs — which Cloud Monitoring then uses to trigger an alert.\n\n### 2a. Navigate to Log-Based Metrics\n1. **GCP Console → Logging → Log-based Metrics**\n2. Click **➕ Create Metric**\n\n### 2b. Configure the Metric\n\n| Field | Value |\n|---|---|\n| **Metric type** | `Counter` |\n| **Name** | `scc-high-critical-findings` |\n| **Description** | `Counts new HIGH and CRITICAL SCC findings` |\n| **Units** | `1` |\n\n### 2c. Build the Log Filter\n\nIn the **Filter** box, paste this filter to match your `snbx04-high-critical-dc` continuous export scope:\n\n```\nresource.type="organization"\nlogName="organizations/[ORG_ID]/logs/cloudaudit.googleapis.com%2Factivity"\nprotoPayload.methodName="google.cloud.securitycenter.v1.SecurityCenter.CreateFinding"\nprotoPayload.request.finding.severity=("CRITICAL" OR "HIGH")\nprotoPayload.request.finding.state="ACTIVE"\n```\n\n> 💡 **Alternative filter** — if your SCC findings flow through a specific project log:\n> ```\n> resource.type="audited_resource"\n> protoPayload.serviceName="securitycenter.googleapis.com"\n> severity=("CRITICAL" OR "ERROR")\n> ```\n\n### 2d. Add Labels *(Optional but recommended)*\nClick **Add Label** to extract useful fields from the log for email context:\n\n| Label Name | Field Name | Type |\n|---|---|---|\n| `severity` | `protoPayload.request.finding.severity` | String |\n| `category` | `protoPayload.request.finding.category` | String |\n| `resource_name` | `protoPayload.resourceName` | String |\n\n### 2e. Save\n- Click **Create Metric** ✅\n- The metric will appear under **Log-based Metrics → User-defined Metrics**\n\n> ⚠️ **Note:** The metric only starts counting **after** it\'s created — it won\'t backfill historical findings.'}]}, {'type': 'function_call', 'id': 'toolu_vrtx_01RSYerYmWVH9w1kutZxNDHw', 'call_id': 'toolu_vrtx_01RSYerYmWVH9w1kutZxNDHw', 'name': 'update_task', 'arguments': '{"id": Channel\n\n### 3a. Navigate to Notification Channels\n1. **GCP Console → Monitoring → Alerting**\n2. Click **Edit Notification Channels** (top right)\n   - OR go to: **Monitoring → Alerting → Notification Channels**\n\n### 3b. Add Email Channel\n1. Scroll to **Email** section → Click **➕ Add New**\n2. Fill in:\n\n| Field | Value |\n|---|---|\n| **Email Address** | `security-team@yourdomain.gov` |\n| **Display Name** | `SCC Security Alerts Team` |\n\n3. Click **Save** ✅\n\n### 3c. Add Multiple Recipients *(Optional)*\n> Cloud Monitoring supports **one email per channel**, but you can add multiple channels and assign them all to one alerting policy.\n\nRepeat Step 3b for each recipient:\n- `manager@yourdomain.gov` → Display Name: `Security Manager`\n- `soc-team@yourdomain.gov` → Display Name: `SOC Team`\n\n> 💡 **Tip:** Use a **Google Group / distribution list email** (e.g., `scc-alerts-group@yourdomain.gov`) as a single channel to notify many recipients at once — no need to add individual channels!\n\n### 3d. 'assistant', 'content': [{'type': 'output_text', 'text': '---\n\n## 🔧 Step 4 — Create the Alerting Policy\n\n> This is the core step that **ties the log-based metric to the email notification.**\n\n### 4a. Navigate to Alerting\n1. **GCP Console → Monitoring → Alerting**\n2. Click **➕ Create Policy**\n\n---\n\n### 4b. Add a Condition (What triggers the alert)\n\n1. Click **➕ Add Condition**\n2. Select **"Metric threshold"**\n3. In the metric picker:\n   - Click **Select a metric**\n   - Under **Resource type**, select: `Global`\n   - Under **Metric**, search for: `scc-high-critical-findings`\n   - Select: `logging/user/scc-high-critical-findings`\n4. Configure the condition:\n\n| Field | Value |\n|---|---|\n| **Condition type** | `Threshold` |\n| **Alert trigger** | `Any time series violates` |\n| **Threshold position** | `Above threshold` |\n| **Threshold value** | `0` *(alert on ANY new finding)* |\n| **For** (duration) | `0 minutes` *(trigger immediately)* |\n\n5. Click **Next** ✅\n\n---\n\n### 4c. Configure Notifications (Who gets alerted)\n\n1. Under **Notification Channels**, click **Manage Notification Channels**\n2. Select the email channel(s) you created in Step 3:\n   - ✅ `SCC Security Alerts Team`\n   - ✅ *(any additional channels)*\n3. Click **OK**\n\n---\n\n### 4d. Configure Alert Details (Alert content)\n\n| Field | Value |\n|---|---|\n| **Alert policy name** | `SCC High-Critical Findings Alert` |\n| **Severity** | `Critical` |\n| **Documentation** | *(paste below)* |\n\nIn the **Documentation** field, add this custom message that will appear in every alert email:\n\n```\n🚨 New HIGH or CRITICAL SCC Finding Detected\n\nThis alert was triggered by the continuous export:\nsnbx04-high-critical-dc\n\nSeverity Filter : HIGH, CRITICAL\nState           : ACTIVE\n\n🔗 Review findings in SCC Console:\nhttps://console.cloud.google.com/security/command-center/findings\n\n📋 Filter to apply in SCC:\nseverity="HIGH" OR severity="CRITICAL"\nstate="ACTIVE"\n\nPlease review and remediate within your SLA window.\n```\n\n---\n\n### 4e. Set Notification Timing *(Daily Digest Option)*\n\n> By default, alerts fire on **every new finding**. To get a **daily digest** instead:\n\n1. Under **Notifications**, expand **Notification rate limit**\n2. Set: **"Notify at most every"** → `1 day`\n   - This batches alerts and sends **at most one email per day** ✅\n   - Ideal for avoiding alert fatigue from many findings\n\n---\n\n### 4f. Best Practices\n\n### 6a. Reduce Alert Fatigue — Notification Rate Limiting\n\n| Goal | Setting |\n|---|---|\n| Alert on every finding | Rate limit: `5 minutes` |\n| Daily digest summary | Rate limit: `1 day` |\n| Weekly summary | Rate limit: `1 week` |\n\nSet under: **Alerting Policy → Edit → Notifications → Notify at most every**\n\n---\n\n### 6b. Align Log Filter with Your SCC Continuous Export Filter\n\nSince your export `snbx04-high-critical-dc` already has a **specific filter**, mirror it exactly in your log-based metric filter. Common SCC filter fields:\n\n```\n# Match specific project (snbx04)\nprotoPayload.request.finding.resourceName=~"projects/snbx04"\n\n# Match severity\nprotoPayload.request.finding.severity=("CRITICAL" OR "HIGH")\n\n# Match only active findings (not resolved)\nprotoPayload.request.finding.state="ACTIVE"\n\n# Exclude specific categories if needed\nprotoPayload.request.finding.category!="MEDIUM_RISK_ONE"\n```\n\n---\n\n### 6c. Incident Auto-Close Setting\n\nUnder **Alerting Policy → Edit → Condition**:\n\n| Field | Recommended Value |\n|---|---|\n| **Incident auto-close duration** | `7 days` *(findings stay open until reviewed)* |\n\n---\n\n### 6d. Troubleshooting Quick Reference\n\n| Issue | Fix |\n|---|---|\n| No email received | Verify notification channel email ✅ |\n| Metric not counting | Check log filter matches actual SCC log entries |\n| Alert not firing | Confirm threshold is `> 0`, duration is `0 min` |\n| Too many emails | Increase notification rate limit to `1 day` |\n| Logs not appearing | Confirm SCC → Cloud Logging integration \\&quot;cancelled\\&quot;: 0}}&quot;\n</details>\n---\n\n## 🔧 Step 2 — Create a Log-Based Metric for SCC Findings\n\n> This creates a **counter metric** that increments every time a new HIGH or CRITICAL SCC finding appears in logs — which Cloud Monitoring then uses to trigger an alert.\n\n### 2a. Navigate to Log-Based Metrics\n1. **GCP Console → Logging → Log-based Metrics**\n2. Click **➕ Create Metric**\n\n### 2b. Configure the Metric\n\n| Field | Value |\n|---|---|\n| **Metric type** | `Counter` |\n| **Name** | `scc-high-critical-findings` |\n| **Description** | `Counts new HIGH and CRITICAL SCC findings` |\n| **Units** | `1` |\n\n### 2c. Build the Log Filter\n\nIn the **Filter** box, paste this filter to match your `snbx04-high-critical-dc` continuous export scope:\n\n```\nresource.type="organization"\nlogName="organizations/[ORG_ID]/logs/cloudaudit.googleapis.com%2Factivity"\nprotoPayload.methodName="google.cloud.securitycenter.v1.SecurityCenter.CreateFinding"\nprotoPayload.request.finding.severity=("CRITICAL" OR "HIGH")\nprotoPayload.request.finding.state="ACTIVE"\n```\n\n> 💡 **Alternative filter** — if your SCC findings flow through a specific project log:\n> ```\n> resource.type="audited_resource"\n> protoPayload.serviceName="securitycenter.googleapis.com"\n> severity=("CRITICAL" OR "ERROR")\n> ```\n\n### 2d. Add Labels *(Optional but recommended)*\nClick **Add Label** to extract useful fields from the log for email context:\n\n| Label Name | Field Name | Type |\n|---|---|---|\n| `severity` | `protoPayload.request.finding.severity` | String |\n| `category` | `protoPayload.request.finding.category` | String |\n| `resource_name` | `protoPayload.resourceName` | String |\n\n### 2e. Save\n- Click **Create Metric** ✅\n- The metric will appear under **Log-based Metrics → User-defined Metrics**\n\n> ⚠️ **Note:** The metric only starts counting **after** it\'s created — it won\'t backfill historical findings.\n<details type="tool_calls" done="true" id="toolu_vrtx_01RSYerYmWVH9w1kutZxNDHw" name="update_task" arguments="&quot;{\\&quot;id\\&quot;: \\&quot;2\\&quot;, \\&quot;status\\&quot;: \\&quot;completed\\&quot;}&quot;" files="" embeds="&quot;&quot;">\n<summary>Tool Executed</summary>\n&quot;{\\&quot;tasks\\&quot;: [{\\&quot;id\\&quot;: \\&quot;1\\&quot;, \\&quot;content\\&quot;: \\&quot;Step 1 — Enable Required APIs\\&quot;, \\&quot;status\\&quot;: \\&quot;completed\\&quot;}, {\\&quot;id\\&quot;: \\&quot;2\\&quot;, \\&quot;content\\&quot;: \\&quot;Step 2 — Create a Log-Based Metric for SCC Findings\\&quot;, \\&quot;status\\&quot;: \\&quot;completed\\&quot;}, {\\&quot;id\\&quot;: \\&quot;3\\&quot;, \\&quot;content\\&quot;: \\&quot;Step 3 — Set Up Email Notification Channel\\&quot;, \\&quot;status\\&quot;: \\&quot;pending\\&quot;}, {\\&quot;id\\&quot;: \\&quot;4\\&quot;, \\&quot;content\\&quot;: \\&quot;Step 4 — Create the Alerting Policy\\&quot;, \\&quot;status\\&quot;: \\&quot;pending\\&quot;}, {\\&quot;id\\&quot;: \\&quot;5\\&quot;, \\&quot;content\\&quot;: \\&quot;Step 5 — Verify &amp; Navigate to Notification Channels\n1. **GCP Console → Monitoring → Alerting**\n2. Click **Edit Notification Channels** (top right)\n   - OR go to: **Monitoring → Alerting → Notification Channels**\n\n### 3b. Add Email Channel\n1. Scroll to **Email** section → Click **➕ Add New**\n2. Fill in:\n\n| Field | Value |\n|---|---|\n| **Email Address** | `security-team@yourdomain.gov` |\n| **Display Name** | `SCC Security Alerts Team` |\n\n3. Click **Save** ✅\n\n### 3c. Add Multiple Recipients *(Optional)*\n> Cloud Monitoring supports **one email per channel**, but you can add multiple channels and assign them all to one alerting policy.\n\nRepeat Step 3b for each recipient:\n- `manager@yourdomain.gov` → Display Name: `Security Manager`\n- `soc-team@yourdomain.gov` → Display Name: `SOC Team`\n\n> 💡 **Tip:** Use a **Google Group / distribution list email** (e.g., `scc-alerts-group@yourdomain.gov`) as a single channel to notify many recipients at once — no need to add individual channels!\n\n### 3d. Verify the Channel\n- Google sends a **verification email** to the address\n- Click the verification link in that email to activate the channel ✅\n<details type="tool_calls" done="true" id="toolu_vrtx_01EcxPdHS771cWykQgjE7C6t" name="update_task" arguments="&quot;{\\&quot;id\\&quot;: \\&quot;3\\&quot;, \\&quot;status\\&quot;: \\&quot;completed\\&quot;}&quot;" files="" embeds="&quot;&quot;">\n<summary>Tool Executed</summary>\n&quot;{\\&quot;tasks\\&quot;: [{\\&quot;id\\&quot;: \\&quot;1\\&quot;, \\&quot;content\\&quot;: \\&quot;Step 1 — Enable Required APIs\\&quot;, \\&quot;status\\&quot;: \\&quot;completed\\&quot;}, {\\&quot;id\\&quot;: \\&quot;2\\&quot;, \\&quot;content\\&quot;: \\&quot;Step 2 — Create a Log-Based Metric for SCC Findings\\&quot;, \\&quot;status\\&quot;: \\&quot;completed\\&quot;}, {\\&quot;id\\&quot;: \\&quot;3\\&quot;, \\&quot;content\\&quot;: \\&quot;Step 3 — Set Up Email Notification Channel\\&quot;, \\&quot;status\\&quot;: \\&quot;completed\\&quot;}, {\\&quot;id\\&quot;: \\&quot;4\\&quot;, \\&quot;content\\&quot;: \\&quot;Step 4 — Create the Alerting Policy\\&quot;, \\&quot;status\\&quot;: \\&quot;pending\\&quot;}, {\\&quot;id\\&quot;: \\&quot;5\\&quot;, \\&quot;content\\&quot;: \\&quot;Step 5 — Verify &amp; Test the Alert\\&quot;, \\&quot;status\\&quot;: \\&quot;pending\\&quot;}, {\\&quot;id\\&quot;: \\&quot;6\\&quot;, \\&quot;content\\&quot;: \\&quot;Step 6 — Optional Tuning &amp; Best Practices\\&quot;, \\&quot;status\\&quot;: \\&quot;pending\\&quot;}], \\&quot;summary\\&quot;: {\\&quot;total\\&quot;: 6, \\&quot;pending\\&quot;: 2, \\&quot;in_progress\\&quot;: 1, \\&quot;completed\\&quot;: 3, \\&quot;cancelled\\&quot;: 0}}&quot;\n</details>\n---\n\n## 🔧 Step 4 — Create the Alerting Policy\n\n> This is the core step that **ties the log-based metric to the email notification.**\n\n### 4a. Navigate to Alerting\n1. **GCP Console → Monitoring → Alerting**\n2. Click **➕ Create Policy**\n\n---\n\n### 4b. Add a Condition (What triggers the alert)\n\n1. Click **➕ Add Condition**\n2. Select **"Metric threshold"**\n3. In the metric picker:\n   - Click **Select a metric**\n   - Under **Resource type**, select: `Global`\n   - Under **Metric**, search for: `scc-high-critical-findings`\n   - Select: `logging/user/scc-high-critical-findings`\n4. Configure the condition:\n\n| Field | Value |\n|---|---|\n| **Condition type** | `Threshold` |\n| **Alert trigger** | `Any time series violates` |\n| **Threshold position** | `Above threshold` |\n| **Threshold value** | `0` *(alert on ANY new finding)* |\n| **For** (duration) | `0 minutes` *(trigger immediately)* |\n\n5. Click **Next** ✅\n\n---\n\n### 4c. Configure Notifications (Who gets alerted)\n\n1. Under **Notification Channels**, click **Manage Notification Channels**\n2. Select the email channel(s) you created in Step 3:\n   - ✅ `SCC Security Alerts Team`\n   - ✅ *(any additional channels)*\n3. Click **OK**\n\n---\n\n### 4d. Configure Alert Details (Alert content)\n\n| Field | Value |\n|---|---|\n| **Alert policy name** | `SCC High-Critical Findings Alert` |\n| **Severity** | `Critical` |\n| **Documentation** | *(paste below)* |\n\nIn the **Documentation** field, add this custom message that will appear in every alert email:\n\n```\n🚨 New HIGH or CRITICAL SCC Finding Detected\n\nThis alert was triggered by the continuous export:\nsnbx04-high-critical-dc\n\nSeverity Filter : HIGH, CRITICAL\nState           : ACTIVE\n\n🔗 Review findings in SCC Console:\nhttps://console.cloud.google.com/security/command-center/findings\n\n📋 Filter to apply in SCC:\nseverity="HIGH" OR severity="CRITICAL"\nstate="ACTIVE"\n\nPlease review and remediate within your SLA window.\n```\n\n---\n\n### 4e. Set Notification Timing *(Daily Digest Option)*\n\n> By default, alerts fire on **every new finding**. To get a **daily digest** instead:\n\n1. Under **Notifications**, expand **Notification rate limit**\n2. Set: **"Notify at most every"** → `1 day`\n   - This batches alerts and sends **at most one email per day** ✅\n   - Ideal for avoiding alert fatigue from many findings\n\n---\n\n### 4f. Save the Policy\n1. Review all settings\n2. Click **Create Policy** ✅\n\nYour alerting policy is now **active and monitoring** for new HIGH/CRITICAL SCC findings!\n<details type="tool_calls" done="true" id="toolu_vrtx_018AkLt7Ya5rTQ5Nt9vFfJKA" name="update_task" arguments="&quot;{\\&quot;id\\&quot;: \\&quot;4\\&quot;, \\&quot;status\\&quot;: \\&quot;completed\\&quot;}&quot;" files="" embeds="&quot;&quot;">\n<summary>Tool Executed</summary>\n&quot;{\\&quot;tasks\\&quot;: [{\\&quot;id\\&quot;: \\&quot;1\\&quot;, \\&quot;content\\&quot;: \\&quot;Step 1 — Enable Required APIs\\&quot;, \\&quot;status\\&quot;: \\&quot;completed\\&quot;}, {\\&quot;id\\&quot;: \\&quot;2\\&quot;, \\&quot;content\\&quot;: \\&quot;Step 2 — Create a Log-Based Metric for SCC Findings\\&quot;, \\&quot;status\\&quot;: \\&quot;completed\\&quot;}, {\\&quot;id\\&quot;: \\&quot;3\\&quot;, \\&quot;content\\&quot;: \\&quot;Step 3 — Set Up Email Notification Channel\\&quot;, \\&quot;status\\&quot;: \\&quot;completed\\&quot;}, {\\&quot;id\\&quot;: \\&quot;4\\&quot;, \\&quot;content\\&quot;: \\&quot;Step 4 — Create the Alerting Policy\\&quot;, \\&quot;status\\&quot;: \\&quot;completed\\&quot;}, {\\&quot;id\\&quot;: \\&quot;5\\&quot;, \\&quot;content\\&quot;: \\&quot;Step 5 — Verify &amp; Confirm the Alerting Policy is Active\n1. **GCP Console → Monitoring → Alerting → Policies**\n2. Find `SCC High-Critical Findings Alert`\n3. Status should show: 🟢 **No incidents** (healthy/active)\n\n### 5b. Test by Writing a Test Log Entry\nUse **Log Explorer** to simulate a matching log entry:\n\n```bash\ngcloud logging write scc-test-log \\\n  \'{\n    "message": "Test SCC HIGH finding",\n    "severity": "CRITICAL",\n    "protoPayload": {\n      "serviceName": "securitycenter.googleapis.com",\n      "methodName": "google.cloud.securitycenter.v1.SecurityCenter.CreateFinding",\n      "request": {\n        "finding": {\n          "category": "OPEN_FIREWALL",\n          "severity": "CRITICAL",\n          "state": "ACTIVE"\n        }\n      }\n    }\n  }\' \\\n  --severity=CRITICAL \\\n  --project=[PROJECT_ID]\n```\n\n### 5c. Verify Alert Triggered\n1. **Monitoring → Alerting** → check for a new **Incident** entry\n2. Check your **email inbox** for the alert notification\n3. Check **SendGrid Activity** — *(N/A for this option — email is sent directly by Google)*\n\n### 5d. Check Log-Based Metric is Counting\n1. **Logging → Log-based Metrics → `scc-high-critical-findings`**\n2. Click the metric → **View in Metrics Explorer**\n3. Confirm the counter is incrementing ✅\n<details type="tool_calls" done="true" id="toolu_vrtx_01Hx8t9oso6GZuZDq4Qc2mVv" name="update_task" arguments="&quot;{\\&quot;id\\&quot;: \\&quot;5\\&quot;, \\&quot;status\\&quot;: \\&quot;completed\\&quot;}&quot;" files="" embeds="&quot;&quot;">\n<summary>Tool Executed</summary>\n&quot;{\\&quot;tasks\\&quot;: [{\\&quot;id\\&quot;: \\&quot;1\\&quot;, \\&quot;content\\&quot;: \\&quot;Step 1 — Enable Required APIs\\&quot;, \\&quot;status\\&quot;: \\&quot;completed\\&quot;}, {\\&quot;id\\&quot;: \\&quot;2\\&quot;, \\&quot;content\\&quot;: \\&quot;Step 2 — Create a Log-Based Metric for SCC Findings\\&quot;, \\&quot;status\\&quot;: \\&quot;completed\\&quot;}, {\\&quot;id\\&quot;: \\&quot;3\\&quot;, \\&quot;content\\&quot;: \\&quot;Step 3 — Set Up Email Notification Channel\\&quot;, \\&quot;status\\&quot;: \\&quot;completed\\&quot;}, {\\&quot;id\\&quot;: \\&quot;4\\&quot;, \\&quot;content\\&quot;: \\&quot;Step 4 — Create the Alerting Policy\\&quot;, \\&quot;status\\&quot;: \\&quot;completed\\&quot;}, {\\&quot;id\\&quot;: \\&quot;5\\&quot;, \\&quot;content\\&quot;: \\&quot;Step 5 — Verify &amp; Reduce Alert Fatigue — Notification Rate Limiting\n\n| Goal | Setting |\n|---|---|\n| Alert on every finding | Rate limit: `5 minutes` |\n| Daily digest summary | Rate limit: `1 day` |\n| Weekly summary | Rate limit: `1 week` |\n\nSet under: **Alerting Policy → Edit → Notifications → Notify at most every**\n\n---\n\n### 6b. Align Log Filter with Your SCC Continuous Export Filter\n\nSince your export `snbx04-high-critical-dc` already has a **specific filter**, mirror it exactly in your log-based metric filter. Common SCC filter fields:\n\n```\n# Match specific project (snbx04)\nprotoPayload.request.finding.resourceName=~"projects/snbx04"\n\n# Match severity\nprotoPayload.request.finding.severity=("CRITICAL" OR "HIGH")\n\n# Match only active findings (not resolved)\nprotoPayload.request.finding.state="ACTIVE"\n\n# Exclude specific categories if needed\nprotoPayload.request.finding.category!="MEDIUM_RISK_ONE"\n```\n\n---\n\n### 6c. Incident Auto-Close Setting\n\nUnder **Alerting Policy → Edit → Condition**:\n\n| Field | Recommended Value |\n|---|---|\n| **Incident auto-close duration** | `7 days` *(findings stay open until reviewed)* |\n\n---\n\n### 6d. Troubleshooting Quick Reference\n\n| Issue | Fix |\n|---|---|\n| No email received | Verify notification channel email ✅ |\n| Metric not counting | Check log filter matches actual SCC log entries |\n| Alert not firing | Confirm threshold is `> 0`, duration is `0 min` |\n| Too many emails | Increase notification rate limit to `1 day` |\n| Logs not appearing | Confirm SCC → Cloud Logging integration Here\'s the breakdown:\n\n```bash\ngcloud logging write [LOG_ID] [MESSAGE]\n#                    ↑\n#          This is just a label YOU choose.\n#          It creates a NEW custom log entry\n#          under that name — NOT an actual SCC log.\n```\n\n### What log name does it actually create?\n```\n# It gets written as:\nprojects/[PROJECT_ID]/logs/scc-test-log\n\n# Full logName in Cloud Logging:\nlogName="projects/[PROJECT_ID]/logs/scc-test-log"\n```\n> ⚠️ This is a **fake/synthetic log** — it does **NOT** simulate a real SCC finding log entry. The `protoPayload` fields in a real SCC audit log are structured differently and cannot be replicated with `gcloud logging write`.\n\n---\n\n## 🔍 How to Verify What Log Name Was Created\n\n### After running `gcloud logging write scc-test-log ...`, query it back:\n\n```bash\n# Find the custom test log you just wrote\ngcloud logging read \\\n  \'logName="projects/\'$PROJECT_ID\'/logs/scc-test-log"\' \\\n  --project=$PROJECT_ID \\\n  --freshness=1h \\\n  --limit=5 \\\n  --format="value(timestamp, logName, jsonPayload)"\n```\n\n---\n\n## 🔍
